summary: Short shaded kerb on Douglas Street, apartments 20 m away, steep grade.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 20 m and 28 m away, houses 29 m and further; homes all round within about 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street kerb where cars park; section is only 10 m, enough for one van.
drivers.traffic: Moderate residential street, lit by nothing known; some passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs nearby, so a van would not stand out much.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section; shade most of the day.

best_section.where: East kerb of Douglas Street, under tree canopy near the bend
